clips.title: The story
paras: Make Yourself Useful is an assignment at Windfield Orchard where adventurers help secure the stormapple crop against undisciplined bandits. An extortionist named Ferauu is due to collect his regular share of the harvest, but hungry outlaws have broken ranks to pilfer the trees ahead of time. Dealing with these rogue thieves earns the respect of the watchful orchard keeper.

At Windfield Orchard, farming is complicated by extortion. A bandit leader named Ferauu and his crew have established an arrangement to collect their regular cut of the fruit harvest. However, lack of discipline within the bandit ranks means that petty outlaws cannot always wait for their boss's scheduled visit, sneaking in early to pick over the trees.

Rather than enduring undisciplined thieves among the stormapple trees, the orchard caretaker puts ambitious newcomers to work before Ferauu's scheduled arrival. Adventurers are tasked with securing the ripe stormapple yield and dispatching the hungry bandits trespassing among the trees. The keeper notes that Ferauu would likely execute these rogues himself for going behind his back and tampering with the cut.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.
Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.
Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me.
Let's see what you've got in a fight.

clips.title: Progress
paras: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
